title: Lily Leap
theme: A tiny geometric salamander hops across floating lily pads in a twilight pond, collecting fireflies to illuminate the way to a glowing lotus gate
mechanics: Jump between platforms to reach the lotus gate at the top of each level
Collect glowing firefly pickups to fill a progress meter
Collect all fireflies on each level to fully open the gate
Progress through 5 hand-crafted levels of increasing difficulty

controls.key: Space or Click or Up Arrow
